payload.title: 20 Greece Wedding Venues From the Islands to Athens
payload.audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with a budget of AUD 150k or more, often with parents contributing, planning 60 to 150 guests who will mostly fly in from Australia. They have chosen Greece but not yet an island or region, have a few Santorini names from Instagram, and want to see credible luxury options beyond the caldera (Mykonos, Paros, Crete, Rhodes, Corfu, the Athens Riviera, the Peloponnese), compared on the same terms: ceremony options, capacity, rooms on site, exclusive use, how guests get there, and when to go.
payload.goal: Speak with a Wedded Advisor: request a Wedded Concierge consultation so an advisor can check availability, ceremony options and house rules for the couple's shortlisted Greek venues on their dates and guest count, quoted in AUD.
payload.angle: Most 'Greece wedding venues' pages are Santorini lists with a nod to Mykonos. This guide treats Greece as six wedding regions with different logistics, and only lists venues whose own official site says they host weddings. Every entry uses the same fields in the same order (setting, ceremony options as the venue states them, capacity and rooms where published, exclusive use where offered, one standout detail), and house rules a venue does not publish are named as 'Not published' for the Wedded Advisor to confirm in writing. Around the venues sit the practical questions an Australian guest list raises: which airport or ferry, how island-hopping guests move, what the summer wind and wildfire season mean for dates, and civil, Orthodox or symbolic ceremonies from Australian Government sources.
must_include: Direct answer in the first 100 words: Greece's main wedding regions and that the right one depends on guest count, ceremony type and how guests travel; link the hub /destinations/europe/greece prominently as the curated collection.

How to compare Greek venues like for like: hotel or resort vs private villa with exclusive use vs historic or estate venue; ceremony type on site; seated capacity; rooms on site; access (ferry, flight, transfer); a comparison table of the final list with 'Not published' where a field is not published.

20 venues by region (Santorini; Mykonos and other Cyclades; Crete; Rhodes and the Dodecanese; Corfu and the Ionian; Athens and the Athens Riviera; the Peloponnese), each verified on its own official site as hosting weddings, same fields in the same order. House rules not published are written 'Not published' with one line per section that the Wedded Advisor confirms them in writing, and added to a booking checklist. Swap unconfirmable candidates; do not pad. No prices.
Getting there: international arrival via Athens, domestic flights and ferries or catamarans to the islands, transfers; practical, no unsourced times or distances.

Season and wind: wedding season and the summer meltemi only as visitgreece.gr or another official source states it; Smartraveller (updated 30 September 2026) on summer wildfires June to September and heatwaves.

Legal in brief: civil, Greek Orthodox and symbolic ceremonies from the Australian Embassy Athens and Smartraveller facts in content/posts/greek-wedding-traditions/03-source-pack*.json, re-checked; link /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once.

FAQ (4 to 6): Can Australians legally marry in Greece? Which Greek island is best for a wedding? When is wedding season and what about wind? Can we book a venue for exclusive use? How do guests get between islands? Santorini or Mykonos or the mainland?

Closing route to Wedded Concierge (/wonderland-concierge) with brand-facts claims only: one Wedded Advisor checks availability and house rules for the shortlist, quotes in AUD, confirms inclusions in writing. Invitation after the comparison table and at the close. UTMs utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=greece-wedding-venues&utm_content=primary|secondary.
avoid: Any price, fee or amount; any capacity, room count, distance or time not on an official source.
Copying the hub's venue claims (e.g. Le Ciel capacity) without official-site verification; repeating the hub's U.S.-citizen legal framing.
Research talk in copy (what we could or could not find or confirm, sources, method, 'you will often read', myths sections); per-line source credits; hedge stacking.
Ranking as 'best'; order by region with a stated logic.
Competitor wedding sites, directories, vendor blogs, review sites or Wikipedia as sources; competitor wording or images.
Vendor names other than venues; venue contact details; implying partnerships or preferred rates.
Wedded Privileges or inclusions beyond brand-facts.md; 'from first idea to the last dance', 'last dance'.
Clichés (fairytale, dream day, breathtaking), exclamation marks, keywords in brackets in headings, em dashes, US spelling.
AI images of any venue or destination.
payload.cannibalisation_check: Real overlap: the live hub /destinations/europe/greece has title 'Greece Wedding Venues: Curated Island & Mainland Luxury' and meta keyword 'greece wedding venues'. Fetched 2026-11-09 (02-research/pages/greece-hub.md): it is Santorini-led (Le Ciel, Santorini Gem, Cavo Ventus, Rocabella; cards for Rocabella and Sea View by En Kipo), Mykonos gets a paragraph with no venues, other regions are named only in passing, legal and FAQ are framed for U.S. citizens, no comparison table, no getting-there, no wind. This guide is the editorial companion: 20 verified venues across six regions, like-for-like fields and table, practical sections for an Australian guest list, and it links the hub prominently as the curated collection. SEO to pull hub rankings for the keyword and variants and recommend the split (e.g. hub keeps 'greece wedding venues' commercial intent, guide takes regional and list variants, or the reverse) in the run report; nothing on the live site changes. Other overlaps: /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions and /8-greek-wedding-traditions-you-didnt-know-about (traditions intent, link the former once); /venue/rocabella-santorini-hotel-spa and /venue/sea-view-by-en-kipo (single-venue pages, supporting links).
